description: Save a private credit research objective for this account: borrowers, a sponsor's borrowers or a lender's book, and the changes to watch (non-accrual, lender exit or entry, maturity, spread, PIK, marks). Returns a watch id and a first checkpoint. Needs a DFX account key.

baseline.description: Record conclusions about each borrower at the first checkpoint (default true).

conditions.description: Which changes to watch; default all measured ones.

include_failing.description: Also watch types measured above 10% false (exits, first appearances, PIK added, recoveries), verified ones only.

include_historical.description: Also show filings older than the checkpoint that were ingested since.

include_unmeasured.description: Also watch footnote and N-PORT types (non-accrual, default) that the quality sample could not check.

maturity_within_months.description: Keep only borrowers with debt maturing inside this window.

scope.description: What to watch: kind borrowers (their ids), sponsor (its current borrowers) or lender (a BDC's book at its latest quarter), and ids of the form dfx:pc:<uuid>.

name: watch_create
title: Create a research watch
